points.description: States that John did NOT control the variables well, because he changed two variables at once (amount of water and amount of plant food) between the pots, so he cannot tell which variable caused the difference in results. Equivalent wording accepted.

rubric.notes: Full mark: says no, and explains that both water and plant food differed so the cause of the results can't be identified. No mark for 'no' alone or for a wrong reason (e.g. soil or seeds differed). Saying yes earns nothing.
